verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents its own background automations. Snowpipe continuously and automatically loads files as they arrive, replacing manually run COPY statements. dbt Projects on Snowflake also claims to orchestrate transformations on managed runtimes. These cover data-pipeline automation, but the pack does not document a general-purpose scheduler or task system, or agent-driven automations that run unattended. Streams only record changes so that actions can be taken, which is a building block rather than an automation. Missing for 10: a documented general scheduling/task engine (one-off vs recurring schedules), autonomous agent-driven background automations, and independent corroboration of the orchestration depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Snowpipe continuously loads data from files into standard tables and Apache Iceberg™ tables as the files arrive in a stage.
making it available to users within minutes, rather than manually executing COPY statements on a schedule
dbt Projects on Snowflake brings the full dbt lifecycle into Snowflake: develop, deploy, orchestrate, and observe your transformations in the same place your data already lives.
No infrastructure to manage: Snowflake provides managed dbt Core and dbt Fusion runtimes.
